title: Prismshot
description: Take beautiful high-resolution screenshots in Minecraft with an integrated Screenshot Gallery for Fabric & NeoForge
body:
# Prismshot

Take beautiful high-resolution screenshots in Minecraft with an integrated Screenshot Gallery.

Prismshot began as a port of [Fabrishot](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabrishot), but has grown into its own screenshot mod with exclusive features, support for both **Fabric** and **NeoForge**, and a built-in Screenshot Gallery for managing your captures without leaving the game.

> Originally based on [Fabrishot](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabrishot).

> On Minecraft **1.21.11**, a 4× (8K) capture typically takes about **1 second**. On Minecraft **26.1+**, the same capture usually takes around **3 seconds** due to Mojang's heavier rendering pipeline. For faster captures, we recommend using **2× (4K)**.

**Please download these mods before installing Prismshot**
- [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) (If you are using NeoForge, you only need to install Cloth Config)
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)

## Features

- Capture screenshots at resolutions up to **65,535 × 65,535** pixels (hardware permitting)
- Default **4K (3840×2160)** capture — 4× sharper than vanilla F2 screenshots
- Fully configurable capture resolution, delay, filename, and output format
- Save screenshots as **PNG, JPG, BMP, or TGA**
- Customizable filename templates using `%time%` and `%world%`
- Optional automatic HUD hiding during capture
- Built-in **Screenshot Gallery** featuring:
  - Thumbnail previews
  - Search
  - Sorting
  - Favorites
  - Rename
  - Delete
- Supports both **Fabric** and **NeoForge**
- Supports multiple Minecraft versions

## Keybindings

| Key | Action |
|------|--------|
| **F9** | Take a high-resolution screenshot |
| **M** | Open the Prismshot configuration |
| **U** | Open the Screenshot Gallery |

All keybinds can be customized in **Options → Controls**.
